abilities.effect: Rocks tumble and slip beneath its feet. The triggering creature must attempt a DC 21 Reflex save as they tumble against the rocks, which deal 2d10+13 bludgeoning damage.
abilities.failure: The creature takes full damage, falls prone in its space, and tumbles down to the bottom of the slope.
abilities.name: Rockslide
abilities.success: The creature takes half damage and falls prone in its space.
abilities.trigger: A creature steps on the unstable ground

hazard.description: The footing on this sloped ground appears to be stable at first glance, but the tiny rocks that cover it are loosely packed and prone to slipping.
hazard.disable: DC 20 Survival (trained) to navigate a safe path
hazard.name: Treacherous Scree

traits.name: Environmental
traits.text: A hazard with this trait is something dangerous that’s part of the natural world, such as quicksand or harmful mold.
